scope: next-stage items 1-8 GUI acceptance slice; items 9-10 excluded by user request

report.evidence: real Electron report navigation, tooltip, link click and scroll-preserving checks

workflowCatalog.evidence: real Electron grouped skill inventory, six direction values, keyboard navigation, dark/narrow layout and no network/model calls

taskDelivery.evidence: real Electron preload/IPC artifact preview, resource readers, PDF/HTML sandbox, script source handling, task snapshots and delivery checks

knowledge.evidence: Knowledge binding refreshed successfully; overview shows vault with 2 notes and 1 literature item, network tab renders 1 note/0 links, settings shows the isolated Vault and completed local index, and the source reader opens Library/Papers/acceptance-note.md with line range L1–7.

home.evidence: New-task home renders with project path, composer, knowledge card (2 notes), research entry point and continuation card; after optional plugin and MCP rollback it still renders normally.

skills.evidence: Skills & Connections page renders plugin, market, connector, MCP and skill categories; installed package row displays desktop-ui-pack@0.1.1 and its declared ui/drone-desktop/filesystem/network/subprocess/externalWrites values.

uiPluginLifecycle.evidence: Installed @gyoungwe/desktop-ui-pack@0.1.1 through the package row, observed enabled toggle and Research status Desktop UI contribution, then disabled it; both row and contribution returned to off without affecting the host home page.

mcp.evidence: MCP page discovered acceptance-echo from isolated agent/mcp.json, showed 1 detected tool and the server details panel with config path; disabling it removed the server and the page reported no MCP configured.

mcpToolCall.command: formal Electron GUI MCP test connection
mcpToolCall.evidence: The UI probe returned “未连接: cached”; the isolated package had no model provider, so no model-backed session could issue the echo_marker call. This is recorded as blocked rather than treating cached tool discovery as a call receipt.

citation.evidence: Knowledge overview opened the seeded literature item; the reader displayed the source path Library/Papers/acceptance-note.md, content marker DRONE-GUI-CITATION-20261024 and line range L1–7.

rollback.evidence: Disabled desktop-ui-pack and acceptance-echo through their UI switches; host returned to the new-task home with the knowledge card and no crash. Final isolated state leaves both optional integrations disabled.

staticGates.mcpCall: BLOCKED: no model provider in isolated formal-package run

formalPackage.evidence: Launched the installed Electron binary with isolated HOME, PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, DRONE_KNOWLEDGE_DIR and --user-data-dir; no production Vault or session state was used.

notes: Only temporary isolated directories were used; no credentials, production Vault, session正文 or results were copied into the repository.
The MCP acceptance is split into discovery/lifecycle PASS and tool-call BLOCKED because a real model-backed session was unavailable in the isolated package.
